about: The night shift: who the overtime crew are and what they say when the engineer stops to talk. Read by game/incidents/dialogues.gd; voiced by tools/voices.py talk.

jo.direction: Nervous, eager, a little too fast.

drew.direction: Polished pitch voice, smiling through it.

dana.direction: Polite overtime small talk; something underneath is wrong.

dana_turning.direction: The same voice, slowing, doubled: the incident speaking through them.

you.direction: The engineer: conversational, exhausted, competent. Dry; never announce the punchline.

shout.direction: The engineer calling a move, anime style: a held beat, then the name at full commitment. Compressed, doubled, arena echo; mastered loud.

monster_record.direction: An accountant fifteen hours into overtime, gone feral.

monster_blocker.direction: The Change Advisory Board as one enormous voice.

monster_scope.direction: A manic product idea that will not stop.

nadia.direction: Hollow-eyed SRE; flat, calm, matter-of-fact about horrors.

val.direction: Executive calm; weaponised positivity; a little unhinged.

rage.direction: The engineer losing it over his dead team: a held breath, then a roar. Distorted, doubled an octave down, crushed and echoing; every word readable.

record.name: DANA
record.wrong: The ledger demanded a blood sample. I offered petty cash. It said my cash wasn't petty enough. Now it wants a finger AND a receipt!
record.snap: I tried. The ledger rebooted me as a deductible expense. My left eye is a rounding error!
record.soon: Stay there. I need to check whether you depreciate when you scream.
record.line: The ledger said hi. Ledgers shouldn't talk.

record.name: RAJ
record.wrong: I migrated the database into my chest. Zero latency! Every heartbeat drops a table. Please stop making me nervous.
record.snap: The last reboot gave me a second spine. High availability. Both spines are the primary. They hate each other!
record.soon: Don't leave. You're the only backup that still has legs.
record.line: The migration is fine. Mostly fine.

record.name: MIGUEL
record.wrong: Cell B twelve contains my mother. She's asking why I don't visit. I merged her with Q three. She has never been so disappointed!
record.snap: If I shut down, the spreadsheet inherits my body. It already changed my emergency contact to SUM!
record.soon: Hold still. I'm dragging your soul down to fill the remaining rows.
record.line: VLOOKUP is looking back at me. I think it's judging my formulas.

record.name: KIM
record.wrong: I billed the moon. It refused to pay. So I repossessed Tuesday. You're welcome. Late fees start in your bones!
record.snap: My eyelids are a subscription now. Blinking costs extra. Procurement says keep them open until death!
record.soon: Your invoice is due. We accept cash, card, and whatever comes out when you crack.
record.line: Invoices don't sleep. Neither do I.

blocker.name: GRETA
blocker.wrong: I swallowed the approval stamp. Every hiccup authorizes a funeral. HIC! Congratulations. Yours is expedited!
blocker.snap: Absolutely not! My off switch is pending approval from my on switch. We have achieved perfect governance!
blocker.soon: Leaving counts as a change. Put your feet back where the committee approved them.
blocker.quip: Has concerns. Will raise them in a meeting.
blocker.line: Has this been approved? In writing?

invite.name: TODD
invite.wrong: I booked a meeting inside your skeleton. Mandatory. Your ribs accepted. Your spine is tentative. I'll chase it!
invite.snap: We can reboot during the break. There is no break. I deleted lunch to improve attendance!
invite.soon: Don't run! I've attached the agenda to your tendons.

scope.name: PRIYA
scope.wrong: I need the office to give birth to another office. By Monday. With parking. The walls are already having contractions!
scope.snap: Great! While you're in there, add a third arm. One for delivery, one for alignment, one to strangle the deadline!
scope.soon: Wait! Your escape needs a premium tier. And teeth. Mostly teeth.
scope.quip: Just one tiny thing before launch.
scope.line: Small ask. Teeny. Barely a requirement.

scope.name: LEO
scope.wrong: We hit a million users! They're all inside me. The retention team welded my mouth shut. I'm speaking through the churn!
scope.snap: Shutdown is churn! Reboot is acquisition! I'll cut myself in half and report one hundred percent growth!
scope.soon: You can leave after you refer three friends. They don't need to be alive.
scope.line: What if it also did… everything?

host_replies.record: Fine. Balanced. Debits equal credits equal debits equal credits equal— why are there three of you? Why do you all disagree?
host_replies.blocker: Your question has been forwarded to the Change Advisory Board. Next meeting: after the heat death of the universe. Please bring a rollback plan.
host_replies.invite: I'm great! Let's sync on how great I am. I've sent you an invite. It's recurring. Forever. You can't decline. I removed the button.
host_replies.scope: Fine! Just one tiny thing. And another. And a dashboard. And AI. And the moon. Small ask. Barely a requirement.

host_soon: See you soon. Very soon. Your ticket is almost ready. It has your name on it. It always did.

Sleeper.role: Platform Team · asleep, technically on call

a.text: …the dashboards are green… the dashboards are always green… don't page me… I'm a load balancer…
replies: Wake up. Production is on fire.
text_variants: ...no, Kevin... don't escalate the dream... I'm already asleep at the highest priority...
...if the dashboard asks, I'm a server... servers don't need annual leave...

wake.text: Production has been on fire since the reorg. I've been on fire since the reorg. We're the same now, production and me. We have matching alerts.
text_variants: Again? Put the fire in the backlog. If it survives until Monday, we'll call it persistent storage.
I woke up for the last outage. They rewarded me with the next outage. I'm trying a different career strategy.

spirit.text: I'm on call in spirit. My body filed for Out Of Office. Legally we're two separate entities now. My body has better benefits.

bleak.text: Bleak is a strong word. I prefer 'operationally mature'. Now lower your voice. My nightmares are running a canary deploy.

tuck.text: Tell my manager I was heads-down. It's not a lie. My head. Is down. On the keyboard. …I think I just approved something.

pager.text: Don't touch the pager. It's been vibrating under me since four PM. I named it Kevin. Kevin is the only one who checks on me.

a.text: Don't look at me. I'm on a different incident.
replies: Help me fight the corrupted records.
text_variants: Before you ask: different incident. Same building, same screaming, separate cost centre.
I'm observing. If I help, I become accountable. The training was very clear about avoiding that.

which.text: INC-000. The incident about having too many incidents. We opened a war room. The war room got its own incident. Now the incidents are unionizing.

process.text: That's process. Insanity is just process without a wiki page.

observer.text: I can add you as an Observer. Observers get every notification and none of the authority. It's like being management, but you're aware of it.

help.text: I'd love to, but my goal this quarter is tickets closed, not monsters killed. If one eats you, I'll close your ticket as Duplicate. Great for my numbers. Thank you for your sacrifice.
text_variants: They only count closed tickets. Kill a monster and it's teamwork. Let it eat the requester and it's a resolved dependency.
My targets say reduce the queue. They don't specify how. I'm waiting for the queue to develop teeth.

watch.text: Watching is a contribution. I'm maintaining situational awareness. It's on my self-review under 'Leadership'. Also under 'Teamwork'. Also under 'Hobbies'.

again.text: Still not my incident. But I've started a document called 'Lessons Learned From Watching You'. Chapter one is just the word 'wow'.
text_variants: I've added your screaming to the timeline. Under 'stakeholder feedback'. Very strong engagement.
Still observing. I've moved from concerned to deeply concerned. That's a promotion in this incident.

Manager.role: Engineering Manager · on a call about the call

a.text: Yes, someone's on it. No, I don't know who. — Oh! You! You're on it? Incredible. Can I put your face in a slide?
text_variants: Oh, excellent, you're here! I told leadership we had ownership. I meant you. The slide just says we.
One second. Yes, leadership, we're all hands on deck! ...Right. You're the hands. I'm the deck.

eta.text: Amazing. I'll tell leadership 'we' are on it. Quick one: can you give me an ETA for the ETA? And how confident are you in the ETA of the ETA, as a percentage?
text_variants: Wonderful. Before you fix it, how long will fixing it take? Before you answer, could the answer be smaller?
I need a number. It doesn't have to be accurate. It has to fit beside the little green arrow.

deck.text: Love it. I'll say two minutes in the deck to show ambition. If it slips, that's a growth opportunity. For you. I'll be growing in a different direction. Upward.

aligned.text: Perfect. I'll write 'aligned on next steps'. That sentence has never been wrong. It has never been anything. It's a shrug wearing a blazer.

managing.text: Managing expectations. Mostly upward. Leadership expects production to be fixed. I expect to be thanked for it. You expect to go home. Two out of three. Very healthy ratio.

growth.text: Unbelievable growth, yes! Put that in your self-review, in the box labelled 'What your manager did'. Use the passive voice. 'Mistakes were fixed.'

help.text: I am helping. I renamed the Slack channel twice. I added an emoji. Morale is up eleven percent. I measured it with a poll. That I answered. Twice.

home.text: Of course! Right after this. And the retro. And the retro about the retro. And the offsite where we discuss why nobody goes home. We're a family here, and families don't log off.

again.text: You again? Is it fixed? No? Then why are you talking to me? I'm in a very important browser tab. It's my calendar. I'm moving things around. Strategically.
text_variants: Any progress? I've changed the channel name to Mission Control. Please deliver a mission we can control.
Quick update: leadership loves our response. They haven't seen the response. I showed them the font.

a.text: Ticket open since 2019. Today's the day. Probably. Me and this microwave have an understanding. It doesn't work, and neither do I.
text_variants: Still waiting on the microwave part. The vendor asked if we needed it urgently. I sent them a photo of my grey hair.
Me and this microwave are both out of warranty. Only one of us is allowed to stop working.

chain.text: Nothing's wrong with it. It's waiting on a part. The part's waiting on a PO. The PO's waiting on budget. Budget's waiting on Q3. Q3 is waiting on the microwave. I've been in this loop so long we're legally married.
text_variants: The part needs a purchase order. The order needs a quote. The quote expired while we approved the order. Beautiful machine. Never moves.
Procurement needs three bids. It's a microwave fuse. At this point I could hire three people to breathe warm air on lunch.

word.text: Don't say that word near it. Last time someone said 'circular dependency' it sparked, the lights went out, and three vice presidents got promoted.

capex.text: A new one is capital expense. Fixing the old one is operating expense. I've spent four years of operating expense avoiding sixty dollars of capital expense. The spreadsheet says I'm winning. I made the spreadsheet.

hand.text: Sure. Hold this wire. No, not that one. Not that one either. — You felt that, right? Good. That means it works. Somewhere. Possibly in your spine.

Standup.role: Feature Team · still in the 9:00 standup

a.text: Yesterday: meetings. Today: meetings. Blockers: meetings. Tomorrow: a meeting about the meetings, which I'm blocked on. By a meeting.
text_variants: Yesterday: waiting for approval. Today: explaining the wait. Tomorrow: approval to stop explaining. No blockers, obviously.
Quick update. Still updating. If I stop talking, the meeting ends, and someone might expect work.

alone.text: The standup. Everyone dropped off at 9:15. This morning. I don't know how to end it. Nobody ever taught me how to end it. I've been giving updates to an empty room for eight hours. The room seems engaged.
text_variants: Everyone left eight hours ago. The meeting bot is still here. It says I'm a key contributor. I think we're engaged.
The standup. I said 'one more thing' this morning and now I'm legally required to keep finding things.

free.text: That's… it… from me. — Oh no. Oh, I'm free. What do I do with my hands? Who do I report my feelings to? Is there a ticket for feelings? Can I point it?

velocity.text: Velocity is up four hundred percent since I started counting every sentence as a story point. This sentence is a three. This one's a five, it's emotionally complex.

blockers.text: You, physically. Also Legal, Procurement, the VPN, the concept of Friday, and a calendar invite called 'Quick Chat', two hours, no agenda, sent by someone who left the company in March.

a.text: Is it normal to be on call on day one? They gave me a pager and a hug. The hug felt like an apology.
text_variants: First day! They gave me a welcome pack and emergency access. The welcome pack had instructions for emergency access. No welcome.
Onboarding said ask lots of questions. So I asked when we go home. They took questions off the agenda.

normal.text: Cool cool cool. They also gave me production access and the root password on a sticky note. The sticky note says 'do not lose'. I've lost it twice. It keeps coming back.
text_variants: Oh, good. My mentor said 'you've got this' and disabled his account. Is that the handover ceremony?
Great! They put me on the escalation list. At the top. I thought that meant employee of the month.

loadbearing.text: I can't. It's load-bearing. The VPN stops working without it. IT says it's 'temporarily permanent'. Like me. Like all of us.

box.text: I can't run, I'm carrying the culture box. It's mostly lanyards and one kombucha. The kombucha is the culture. It's alive. It's been here longer than the CEO.

swag.text: Four hundred t-shirts that say DISRUPT. They disrupted the budget for raises to print them. I got a small. I'm a large. That's also culture. Everything is culture if you're brave enough.

a.text: I'm working from home. This is home now. Return-to-office worked so well, I returned to it permanently.
text_variants: I'm remote. My home is just inside the office now. HR says it counts as culture if I don't call it a housing crisis.
Return to office, they said. Done. Nobody specified a return from office. I've found a policy gap.

live.text: Define 'live'. I have a sofa, a microwave I'm not allowed to use, and a standing desk I sit at. My commute is four metres. I charge my phone from the badge reader. I am the office now.
text_variants: I keep socks in the cable drawer and milk in the server cooling budget. My landlord is a badge scanner. We have our disagreements.
I've got the sofa and a mug with my name on it. That's more security than my last lease. Please don't tell Facilities about the duvet.

certificate.text: Sad? I hit one hundred percent badge-in compliance. HR sent me a certificate. I sleep under it. It's warmer than it looks. On weekends I badge in just to feel something.

a.text: It said one minute. That was forty minutes ago. I've watched it the whole time. We've been through a lot together, me and this burrito.
text_variants: The burrito's still spinning. I've started calling each rotation a milestone. Delivery is looking incredible.
Lunch is delayed. I've given it an extension. It asked for another extension. I think the microwave has learned management.

burrito.text: A burrito. Or it was. It's in a superposition now. Facilities marked it 'pending'. Like my promotion. Like my raise. Like my will to live, which is also in there, slowly rotating.
text_variants: A burrito with a dependency on a microwave with a dependency on Sam. Lunch has more stakeholders than the product.
It was lunch when I put it in. It's dinner now. If I wait long enough, Finance can expense it as a retreat.

sunk.text: And walk away from forty minutes of sunk cost? That's not how we do things here. Here we double down. Ask the roadmap. Ask the blockchain pivot. Ask Gary.

escalate.text: I escalated it. It came back assigned to me, as a Blocker. Now I'm blocking my own burrito. I scheduled a meeting with myself about it. I declined.

denial.text: Don't. I know. I'm in the denial stage. Let me have this. It's the only thing in this building with an honest status light. It says 'nothing is happening'. Respect.

a.text: We're like a family here. A family with KPIs. And a performance review at Thanksgiving.
text_variants: Welcome to the family! No, there's no inheritance. There is a mandatory survey about how loved you feel.
We don't say understaffed. We say everyone has room to grow. Mostly into the jobs of people who left.

family.text: The kind you can't leave, where holidays are optional, and Dad is a quarterly earnings call. Mom is the stock price. We don't talk about Uncle Layoffs.

hiring.text: Always! We need a senior engineer with ten years of experience in a framework released last spring. Compensation: exposure. To production. Directly. Like radiation.
text_variants: Absolutely. The role covers three teams, pays for half a person, and asks you to bring your whole self. The maths is aspirational.
We're seeking a rock star. Someone used to no sleep, screaming crowds, and being paid in drink vouchers.

ownership.text: We prefer 'high-ownership culture'. You own everything. The outages, the pager, the blame. Everything except equity.

sign.text: You already did. Page forty-one of the laptop policy. Welcome back. You never left. Nobody ever leaves. Smile for the careers page.

pay.text: Extremely competitive. Competitive with what, we can't legally disclose. But we have a ping-pong table. Nobody's allowed to use it during business hours, which are all hours. It's a sculpture now.

a.text: Hear that? That's the pager. It isn't ringing. It just lives in my skull now. Rent-free. Only thing in this building that is.
text_variants: My pager's quiet. That's worse. Either production's fine or the alert system's dead. I know which one has budget.
I turned the pager off. I can still hear it. Apparently the company owns the inside of my head too.

sleep.text: Sleep is a legacy system. We sunset it in Q2. I dream in dashboards now. Last night every graph was green. I screamed until I woke up.

incident.text: Which one? I have eleven open. Nine are the same incident wearing different hats. One is a printer. The printer scares me most.
text_variants: The status page is green, the phones are red, and the printer is smoking. Officially we're investigating customer perception.
Eleven open. I merged two and got fourteen. Don't ask me how. The ticket system feeds after sunset.

coffee.text: Coffee stopped working on me in 2021. I still drink it, out of respect. Like visiting a grave.

Director.role: VP of Synergy · promoted for a deck nobody read

a.text: Love this energy! Quick thought: what if the outage is a feature? Outages create urgency. Urgency is engagement. I'm putting it in the deck.
text_variants: Hear me out: premium uptime. We let the free users experience the outage first. That's market segmentation.
Love the urgency. Can we bottle it? Sell it? The board keeps asking what our panic strategy is.

feature.text: Everything is a feature if you believe hard enough. I believed my way into a VP title. I don't know what I do. Nobody does. That's leadership.
text_variants: Of course it's a feature. The product is creating a memorable experience. Nobody remembers a normal Friday.
It's scarcity. Customers value things more when they can't have them. Currently they can't have anything. Incredible value.

deck.text: Too late. Slide forty-seven. It has a rocket on it. The rocket is on fire. The board loved the fire. They think it's a metaphor.

a.text: Don't look at the error page. I redesigned it four times tonight. It has never been more beautiful. It has never been more broken. Those are related.
text_variants: I made the error page warmer. Production's dead, but at least the corpse feels approachable.
The error page now apologises in our brand voice. Legal removed the apology. It's just a tasteful rectangle.

great.text: Thank you. I gave the five hundred page a gradient. Now when production dies, it dies on brand. My husband says I care too much. He's asleep. I'm here, kerning a catastrophe.
text_variants: Thanks. I added rounded corners to the catastrophe. Leadership says it's much less alarming now. Nothing works, but gently.
Thank you. The button says Try Again in a very reassuring font. It doesn't do anything. Research says people enjoy having a button.

home.text: And miss this? My husband texted 'are you alive' an hour ago. I sent him a mockup of the answer. He wants a revision. Marriage is stakeholder management with better snacks.

host_snap.record: Off. And on. Again. Sure. Let's see what boots up. Spoiler: it's not me anymore.
host_snap.blocker: Turning myself off requires a change request. Turning myself on requires two. Denied. Both. Forever.
host_snap.invite: Off and on? Like a meeting that could have been an email? Oh, I'm going to be SO much worse than an email.
host_snap.scope: Ooh, a reboot! Can the new me also have wings? And a dashboard? And teeth? Small ask.

host_hover: …Can I help you? You've been standing there for a while. Breathing. Loudly.
host_hr: Did you just— Okay. I'm telling HR. I'm telling HR right now.

rage.text: YOU LAID OFF MY TEAM… ON A FRIDAY?!
rage.say: You laid off my TEAM!! ... On a FRIDAY?!!

spot: OVERTIME! OVERTIME! HA HA HA HA!
idle: Debits… credits… debits… why are there three of me…
I haven't seen the sun since Q2.
Just one more spreadsheet. Then I'll sleep. In the spreadsheet.
Ha ha ha… the ledger is laughing too… why is the ledger laughing…
attack: LET'S CIRCLE BACK TO YOUR FACE!
death: Tell HR… I was… a team player…
I never… even got… the pizza party…

spot: CHANGE REQUEST… DENIED! HA HA HA!
idle: Form 27-B. In triplicate. Signed in blood.
Every change is a risk. Breathing is a change.
death: Fine… merge it… I don't care anymore…
Who's going to… block things now…

idle: Fifteen minutes… it's always fifteen minutes…
Let's take this offline. Let's take EVERYTHING offline.
attack: RECURRING! FOREVER! HA HA HA HA!
death: This meeting… could have been… an email…
Sorry… I have… a hard stop…
Let's… circle back… in the afterlife…

spot: I WANT IT ALL! I WANT IT YESTERDAY! HA HA HA!
idle: Small ask… small ask… heh heh heh… SMALL ASK!
What if it was also… a blockchain…
death: Was I… ever… in the roadmap…

spot: Hee hee hee! Works on prod? NEVER!

Manager.last: Mark it GREEN on the status report! It's GREEN! IT'S GREEN!

SRE.charge: I'm on call! This is MY call!
SRE.help: It's not in the runbook! HELP!
SRE.last: Not dead! Just… degraded performance! All systems operational!
pain: UGH! That's going in the postmortem!

Designer.help: Tell my husband the kerning was perfect!
Designer.last: Is my blood on brand?! TELL ME IT'S ON BRAND!
pain: OW! Not the face! The face is on brand!
AAGH! My wrists! I need those for Figma!

Intern.help: HELP US! It's my FIRST DAY!
Intern.last: Does this count… for college credit?!

Director.help: Let's circle back! LET'S CIRCLE BACK!
Director.last: Put my death in the deck! Make it a HOCKEY STICK!
